scenes.text: Ever had a long chat with ChatGPT, and it forgot what you said at the start? [1] That's not a bug. It's tokens, and the context window. [2] Let's break it down.

title: Tokens &
Context
data.subtitle: Why AI forgets in long chats

scenes.text: L L Ms don't read words the way we do. [1] They read tokens. Small chunks of text, often a word, or part of a word. [2] Common words are usually one token. [3] Rare words get split into pieces. [4] Numbers and symbols count too.

data.definition: A small chunk of text, a word or a piece of a word, that the model reads.

scenes.text: Here's the idea. [1] A long word like unbelievable can become pieces, like un, believ, able. [2] Roughly, one token is about three quarters of a word. [3] So a hundred tokens is about seventy five words. [4] And AI companies charge per token.

Now, the context window. [1] It's the model's working memory. Your messages and its replies must all fit inside. When the chat gets too long, [2] the oldest messages fall out, and the model forgets them.

data.heading: The context window
data.label: WINDOW: 6 MESSAGES
messages: Sorry, I don't know your name.
data.note: Too long? The oldest messages drop out.

scenes.text: And these windows keep growing. [1] Early chatbots could hold only a few pages. [2] Modern models hold hundreds of thousands of tokens. Entire books, at once.
Why should you care? [1] Cost. More tokens, bigger bill. [2] Long documents may need to be split into chunks. [3] And in long chats, start fresh or ask for a summary, when the AI starts forgetting.
Myth! [1] The AI remembers everything you ever told it. [2] Nope. It only sees what fits in the current context window. Memory features just add saved notes into your prompt, quietly.

data.myth: The AI remembers everything I ever told it.
data.fact: It only sees what fits in the context window. 'Memory' features just add saved notes to your prompt.
data.tip: Long chat acting weird? Start fresh.

scenes.text: Quick quiz! Why did the AI forget your name, in a long chat? [1] Pause and think. <pause 3.2> [2] It fell out of the context window! Comment your answer!

data.question: The AI forgot your name because…
options: It fell out of the context window

scenes.text: Recap. [1] AI reads text as tokens. [2] One token is about three quarters of a word. [3] The context window is its working memory. [4] Too long, and old messages fall out. [5] Next episode, prompt engineering. How to talk to AI, and get great answers. Follow AI Maastaaru!
